message:
The other day, I was chatting with my granddaughter about our family emergency plans. Just as I was about to show her our go-bags, my phone decided to update—right in the middle of our conversation! I laughed, thinking how typical it was that tech would choose that moment to go dark. 

It reminded me of the importance of having paper copies of important documents and plans. You know, those good old-fashioned things that don’t need charging or Wi-Fi! It’s a comforting thought to know that even when technology fails us, we can still be prepared in ways that really count. 

Have you ever had a moment when the tech let you down unexpectedly?
